listing.title: Christmas Cookie Mug, Watercolor Gingerbread Man and Iced Sugar Cookies All Over Print Coffee Mug, Holiday Baking Gift for Bakers
listing.description: Gingerbread men, iced sugar cookies (trees, stars, hearts, mittens and snowflake rounds), candy canes, peppermints and holly, painted in layered watercolor all the way around the mug on a warm cream background. A cheerful mug for the family baker, the cookie-swap host and anyone who starts the holidays in the kitchen.

listing.trademark_check: 2026-10-01, IP & Trademark Counsel: WebSearch '"christmas cookies" trademark registered mugs drinkware uspto' found no CHRISTMAS COOKIES mark for mugs (results: CHRISTMAS CAMP, Reg. 5601319, Class 21, a different phrase, not used); '"cookie season" OR "christmas cookie" trademark justia clothing mugs' found no CHRISTMAS COOKIE mark; it surfaced COOKIEWARE (Class 21), THE COOKIE MUG (1992, cookie delivery), TOUGH COOKIE (clothing), COOKIES (Cookies SF), THE COOKIE JAR and Pepperidge Farm's IF YOU'RE GOING TO HAVE A COOKIE slogan: none is used in our title, tags or art.
